main_body: Snow-capped wooden crate or slatted rack. A thick snow cap sits on top, with a plank front face below it.
top_band: Snow cap, rows 1-8 (white #f6f9fd with pale blue-grey shading), ending in a blue-grey edge at row 8. A step to the tan plank face follows at row 9.
evidence: Column x=16 reads as a light snow top (rows 1-7), a blue-grey edge at row 8, then the tan plank face from row 9 down. The top is clearly lighter than the face and about half as tall. Dark icicle and drip pixels sit under the snow edge as a shadow. Planks sit inside dark frame gaps, so the front reads as inset, and a dark base strip closes the bottom. This is a correct 3/4 drawing of a crate with a snow cap. The kind label 'organic' does not fit, because this is a built prop, not a plant, rock or crystal.

style.evidence: Median is 20 colours per tile, equal to the well reference (20) and above the stall (17). Flat-fill coverage is 0%. The snow has about 5 steps (white, pale blue, blue-grey, mid blue) and the planks have 3-4 tan and brown tones. Only 19% of dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outlines lean brown or blue and are not a black sticker line. Total distinct colours (23) is lower than the references (38-40), but the tile density and the shading are on par.
